MICROSOFT MEGA OUTAGE: REPORT REVEALS TESTING GAPS AND EMAILS THAT NEVER ARRIVED
articles.summary: Microsoft's final incident report reveals how a Windows defect went undetected for months before overwhelming Microsoft 365 gateway servers. At its peak, more than 80% of North American gateway servers were unresponsive. Microsoft identified gaps in load testing, failover procedures, and infrastructure capacity, and plans to improve service isolation and recovery mechanisms.

articles.title: CROWDSTRIKE TO PURCHASE ZSCALER FOR $43.9 BILLION
articles.summary: CrowdStrike has announced an all-stock acquisition of Zscaler, bringing endpoint protection, zero-trust networking, cloud security, and threat intelligence under one platform. Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry will continue leading the business and join CrowdStrike's board. The deal represents a major step toward security platform consolidation and could reshape enterprise security purchasing decisions.

articles.title: EUROPE PUSHES FOR CLOUD SOVEREIGNTY AMID US DOMINANCE
articles.summary: European governments and regulated industries are increasingly incorporating digital sovereignty requirements into cloud procurement contracts to reduce dependence on US technology providers. Although high-profile contracts have been awarded to European and hybrid providers, overall migration remains slow due to strong incumbent lock-in and high migration friction.

articles.title: JENSEN HUANG RETURNS AS CEO OF NVIDIA
articles.summary: Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation following consultations with senior US government officials. The board determined that his reinstatement does not pose a national security risk. Huang's return reduces immediate leadership uncertainty at a critical point in the global AI infrastructure buildout.

articles.title: AI IS CHANGING THE BUILD-VERSUS-BUY EQUATION. ARE CIOS READY?
articles.summary: AI-powered development tools and vibe coding reduce software creation costs but do not eliminate ongoing security, maintenance, and integration expenses. CIOs should selectively reconsider building specialized, non-critical SaaS applications rather than replacing core enterprise platforms, especially as AI tools can introduce security risks without necessarily improving development productivity.

articles.title: SHOULD APPLE REALLY MOVE FAST AND BREAK THINGS?
articles.summary: As Apple faces pressure to accelerate its AI development, its deliberate engineering culture could be a competitive advantage. Introducing unreliable AI capabilities at the operating system level carries greater consequences than standalone chatbot errors, making reliability, privacy, and customer trust particularly important.

articles.title: HOW AI IMPACTED THE RELEASE OF POSTGRES 19
articles.summary: AI-assisted testing uncovered numerous defects during PostgreSQL 19 development, contributing to its delayed release. The experience highlights an emerging engineering challenge: while AI accelerates development and bug discovery, human validation, architectural decisions, and quality assurance remain critical bottlenecks.

articles.title: 📊 HOW MANY DASHBOARDS IS TOO MANY?
articles.summary: Every new monitoring tool, service, or "quick integration" adds another dashboard to the pile—and before you know it, you're spending more time switching between tools than actually building. With Microsoft Azure [12], your entire stack lives in one workspace: infrastructure, data, AI, and more. See how Azure brings it all

AWS SYSTEMS MANAGER AUTOMATION NOW AUTOMATES OPERATIONAL TASKS IN AZURE AND GOOGLE CLOUD
articles.summary: AWS has expanded Systems Manager Automation to support multicloud environments. IT teams can centrally automate configuration remediation, resource cleanup, agent deployment, and infrastructure changes without maintaining separate automation workflows across cloud providers.

articles.title: TOKENLESS AI: SLACKBOT POWERED BY CLAUDE
articles.summary: Slack has introduced Slackbot powered by Claude, offering flat-rate pricing per person on Enterprise+ plans to eliminate per-token usage costs for everyday AI tasks. The company argues that tokenless pricing helps organizations avoid unpredictable AI bills and lets employees use AI freely without rationing adoption. Early users report significant reductions in overage charges and improved workflow efficiency by routing routine queries through Slackbot.

articles.title: CLOUDWATCH OMNI
articles.summary: Amazon has launched CloudWatch Omni, an AI-powered observability solution built on open standards and delivered outside the AWS Console. The platform unifies the monitoring and evaluation of AI agents, applications, and infrastructure across multi-account environments. Designed for development workflows, it integrates directly into IDEs and provides features like auto-discovered topology, natural-language querying, and continuous trace evaluations.

articles.title: WORKDAY COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF C1.AI
articles.summary: Workday has completed its acquisition of C1.ai, formerly ConductorOne, expanding into identity governance. Combining employee lifecycle data with access management capabilities will help organizations automate provisioning, permission management, and security enforcement for employees and AI agents.

articles.title: HOW SECURITY VENDORS ARE TACKLING ACCESS-CONTROL CHALLENGES FOR AI AGENTS
articles.summary: Security vendors are introducing a range of access-control, monitoring, and testing tools to address the unique challenges posed by autonomous enterprise AI agents. Companies such as CrowdStrike, Okta, and Cisco are deploying new capabilities to prevent agents from executing unauthorized actions or falling victim to confused-deputy scenarios. At the same time, industry groups like the Blueprint Alliance are attempting to coordinate standards across vendors for securing agent identities and tasks.

articles.title: AMAZON SCOOPS UP AI ACCELERATOR TECH TO KEEP CHIPS BUSY AT ALL TIMES
articles.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and engineering talent to improve hardware utilization across Nvidia GPUs, Google TPUs, and AWS Trainium chips, targeting faster inference, higher throughput, and lower AI computing costs.

articles.title: NEW OUTLOOK'S ATTACHMENT ISSUES SENT USERS INTO THE ARMS OF ITS PREDECESSOR
articles.summary: Microsoft recommends switching to classic Outlook or its web client after a software update broke attachment handling.

articles.title: CRITICAL CISCO REMOTE CODE EXECUTION BUG UNDER ATTACK
articles.summary: CISA has added a critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability affecting clustered deployments to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

articles.title: AWS CODEDEPLOY NOW SUPPORTS SUSPENDING AMAZON EC2 AUTO SCALING PROCESSES
articles.summary: AWS introduces controls to temporarily suspend Auto Scaling activities during application deployments, preventing instances from being replaced mid-update.
